frames.observation: The curved stalk, four root leaves, plum hood, scalloped lip, teeth, and warm throat form one readable pitcher-plant silhouette in settled idle.
The native lunge bends the stalk while the hood, mouth, and root leaves remain visibly connected; the attack flash obscures part of the lower plant.
The ordinary 58 to 50 hit is visible during hit1. The pitcher head recoils behind the hero and damage UI while remaining joined to the stalk.
A later native attack1 pose again keeps the hood, mouth, stalk, and leaf base continuous, with the attack flash covering some lower surfaces.
The explicit fixture shows the authored pitcher bent during native death with the hood, stalk, and leaves still visibly connected.
The later death pose places the joined pitcher body low across the floor. This selected view does not establish collision, physics sleeping, or corpse lifetime.

conclusion: The reviewed exact-source originals show a coherent authored Belladusk Pitcher through settled idle, two native attack moments, ordinary hit response, and animated fixture death.
limits: Six selected originals were reviewed rather than every rendered pose or camera angle.
Combat UI, the hero, hit flashes, depth effects, and victory progression obscure some surfaces.
The explicit KillSingle fixture is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
m_DoRagdoll is false across all retained capture frames, so the recorded death is animated rather than a body ragdoll.

The retained frames do not establish collision, physics sleeping, a settled corpse, precise visible corpse lifetime, portrait behavior, final resource disposal, full culling coverage, or finished art direction.
This review covers only plantE and enJungleNibbler_A renderer 121530. It does not establish another plant rig.
